name: web-luxury-residential-developer-site-dark-with-gold-cta
title: Dark residential developer site with a giant cropped ELYSIUM GROUP title, stat tiles, project list and gold mobile CTA
whatItIs: A dark brown board with two long page columns and two tilted phones: a hero of a dusk building with a huge light 'ELYSIUM GROUP', About with stat tiles (10+, 7+, 1,200+, 98%), a project list with photo rows, value icons, a project feature, FAQ accordion, contact over a skyline, a giant footer name, and phones with an overview and a full-screen menu with a gold 'Get a consultation' button.
whatItMeans: Refined and premium; warm gold on near-black feels like luxury living.
techniques: Split a giant wordmark across the hero.
List developments as photo rows with hairlines.
Show menu as huge stacked words on mobile.

vocabulary.definition: A huge name partially cut by the hero.
A dark tile with a number and label.
A photo with name and details in a list.
A menu of large words on mobile.
